# StrydeGoSox

> StrydeGoSox makes Pocket Socks: graduated compression socks (20–30 mmHg) that fold down into a pocket-sized pack. One size fits most adults. Built for travel, gym, trips and trekking, road trips and biking, and long office days. Sold online in India at https://strydegosox.com/

## Key facts
- Product: StrydeGoSox Pocket Compression Socks (black and white)
- Compression: graduated, 20–30 mmHg

- Shipping: across India, free shipping on orders ₹1,999+, 30-day returns
